page_title: TOR 1-2 UDI | Torino v Udinese 07/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' Torino fail to score from a corner as Maduka Okoye (Udinese) leaps to collect the ball.

90+4' Cesare Casadei (Torino) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it. The referee blows his whistle, Torino are awarded a corner kick.
90+4' Arthur Atta (Udinese) wriggles into space and fires the ball from the edge of the area, but one of the defenders is there to block the effort.

90+3' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) controls a square pass, he moves forward then unleashes a wild shot from mid-range which goes so far wide it nearly hits the corner flag. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
90+1' Cesare Casadei (Torino) is cautioned and receives a yellow card.
90+1' Che Adams (Torino) is first to the lofted pass but plants a header miles over the bar from close in.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
87' 1 - 2 Cesare Casadei (Torino) leaps to meet a beautiful cross and produces a header which goes low inside the left post.
85' Kosta Runjaic prepares a substitution. Jurgen Ekkelenkamp is replaced by Oier Zarraga (Udinese).
85' Here's the change. Thomas Kristensen leaves the pitch and Nicolo Bertola (Udinese) comes on as a substitute.
84' Referee Fabio Maresca signals that the goal stands after the VAR review and the Udinese players have a reason to celebrate!
83' Celebrations by Udinese are cut short as the referee signals that the legality of the goal will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully this won’t take too long.
82' 0 - 2 Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and coolly sends the ball into the back of the net.
80' Kosta Runjaic has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) replacing Lennon Miller.
79' Che Adams (Torino) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
77' Substitution. Adrien Tameze (Torino) on for Ardian Ismajli.
77' Torino can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
73' Udinese take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

73' Keinan Davis (Udinese) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away. Udinese win a corner.
72' The current number of shots on goal is 2:3.
70' None of the Udinese players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
69' Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) receives a yellow card.
66' Substitution. Zakaria Aboukhlal leaves the pitch and is replaced by Cyril Ngonge (Torino).
66' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Emirhan Ilkhan walks off the pitch to be replaced by Faustino Anjorin (Torino).
66' Giovanni Simeone comes off the pitch to be replaced by Duvan Zapata (Torino).
61' Here is a change. Alessandro Zanoli is going off and Kosta Runjaic gives the last tactical orders to Jakub Piotrowski (Udinese).
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nicolo Zaniolo trots off the pitch and is replaced by Arthur Atta (Udinese).
58' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) tries a pot shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post.
58' Keinan Davis (Udinese) outjumped his marker after a well-taken corner, but his header goes wide of the target.
57' It will be a corner kick for Udinese.
56' Keinan Davis (Udinese) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Alberto Paleari has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
50' 0 - 1 Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) received a delightful pass inside the box before slotting the ball past the goalkeeper. What a brilliant finish!
49' A clumsy foul by Valentino Lazaro (Torino) and Fabio Maresca blows his whistle.

46' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Torino) has time and space to shoot after latching onto a pass, but his screamer of a shot flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
46' Marco Baroni has decided to substitute Alieu Njie and he is replaced by Che Adams (Torino).
46' Fabio Maresca blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
42' Half-chance! Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) plays a pass into the box, but Alberto Paleari reacts well to snuff out the attack.
40' Fabio Maresca blows for a foul after Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.

38' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Alberto Paleari to get hold of the ball.
37' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Torino) has an effort on goal, but he misses to the right of the goal. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
34' A nice lofted cross finds Giovanni Simeone (Torino) unmarked. He takes an excellent touch and gets in a shot that goes towards the middle of the net. An easy save for the goalkeeper, though.
28' A fine move culminates with a precision cross onto the head of Cesare Casadei (Torino) in the centre of the box. It's a good attempt but goes just over the bar.
26' Now Udinese have a corner.
25' Udinese will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
25' Ardian Ismajli (Torino) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Fabio Maresca blows his whistle for a foul.

23' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) hits a screaming first-time shot from the edge of the box from a clearance, but it flies a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
21' Maduka Okoye pulls off a great save to block a header from Cesare Casadei (Torino) after a nice lofted cross.
21' The Udinese players’ celebrations are quickly cut short after referee Fabio Maresca signals NO GOAL following the VAR review due to an offside.
19' Attention! Referee Fabio Maresca straight away wants to review previous situation with VAR, presumably for a possible offside in the build-up.
18' Christian Kabasele (Udinese) has a goal ruled out for offside!
18' Udinese earn a corner.
17' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. Udinese get a corner.
15' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Torino) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
12' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) takes a short free kick.
11' Saul Coco (Torino) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
7' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) serves up a nice cross, but Maduka Okoye punches the ball away.
7' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
5' Alieu Njie (Torino) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
1' One of the Torino players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul. A free kick is awarded to Udinese.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Torino will kick the game off.
Fabio Maresca will officiate today.
